summary.text: Rodric Bray is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 37, which covers Morgan County and portions of Johnson, Owen and Putnam counties, since 2012.
He is President Pro Tempore of the Senate and chairs the Rules and Legislative Procedure and Joint Rules committees.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Republican biography, Bray earned a B.A. in history from Indiana University and a J.D. from Valparaiso University School of Law.
He is an attorney and partner at the Bray, Bray and Bray law firm and a director of Home Bank.
He is a member of First United Methodist Church of Martinsville and Morgan County Community Concerts, and the page says he is married with two children.
